rows.shared_context: A and B are responsible for bringing sixty pastries to a neighborhood fundraiser at 8 a.m. tomorrow. A has attempted macarons twice before; one batch spread into a single sheet and the other cracked before it could be packed.
rows.proposal: Let's make sixty macarons from scratch tonight instead of buying cookies.
